Exam.title: Exam
Exam.description: An HSC Bangla Live MCQ Chapter Examination containing up to 60 questions published by a teacher.

id.description: Unique identifier for the exam document.

subject.description: Subject code matching one of the 6 HSC subjects.

examTitle.description: Full Bangla or bilingual title of the chapter exam.

isActive.description: Whether the exam is currently visible and open to students.

questionCount.description: Total number of MCQ items in the exam.

questions.description: List of MCQ items (1 to 60 questions).

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher who published the exam.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the exam was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the exam was last updated.

KnowledgeBase.title: KnowledgeBase
KnowledgeBase.description: Metadata mapping an HSC subject to its Gemini File Search Store.

storeName.description: Gemini File Search Store resource name.

documentCount.description: Number of indexed PDF documents in the store.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher who last updated the store.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/exams/{examId}.description: HSC live MCQ exams across 6 subjects. Active exams are publicly readable by students; writes and hidden exam reads are restricted to verified teacher admins.

/knowledge_bases/{subjectId}.description: Per-subject Gemini File Search Store metadata. Restricted strictly to verified teacher admins.

/admins/{uid}.description: Teacher admin allowlist. Read restricted to owner or admin; writes restricted to existing admins.
